<set-variable name="aforo-execution-status" value="@{
    var s = context.Response != null ? context.Response.StatusCode : 0;
    if (s < 200 || s > 599) { return ""; }
    var allowed = ",SUCCESS,PARTIAL,TIMEOUT,ERROR,VALIDATION_FAILED,FAILED,FAILURE,CANCELLED,PENDING,BLOCKED,HITL_REQUIRED,";
    var raw = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-status-outcomes", "");
    var picked = "";
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw)) {
      foreach (var part in raw.Split(',')) {
        var kv = part.Split('=');
        if (kv.Length == 2 && kv[0].Trim() == s.ToString()) {
          var o = kv[1].Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
          if (o.Length > 0 && allowed.Contains("," + o + ",")) { picked = o; }
        }
      }
    }
    if (picked.Length > 0) { return picked; }
    if (s < 400) { return "SUCCESS"; }
    if (s == 408 || s == 504) { return "TIMEOUT"; }
    if (s == 499) { return "CANCELLED"; }
    if (s == 400 || s == 422) { return "VALIDATION_FAILED"; }
    if (s == 401 || s == 403 || s == 429) { return "BLOCKED"; }
    return "ERROR";
  }" />
  
  
  
  <set-variable name="aforo-mcp-call" value="@{
    if ("{{aforo-mcp-enabled}}" != "true" || context.Request.Method != "POST") { return ""; }
    try {
      var raw = "";
      if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-mcp-body")) { raw = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-mcp-body"]); }
      else if (context.Request.Body != null) { raw = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true); }
      if (raw == null || !raw.Contains("tools/call")) { return ""; }
      var body = JObject.Parse(raw);
      if (Convert.ToString(body["method"]) != "tools/call") { return ""; }
      var tool = "";
      var agent = "";
      var p = body["params"];
      if (p != null) {
        tool = Convert.ToString(p["name"]);
        var meta = p["_meta"];
        if (meta != null) { agent = Convert.ToString(meta["agent_id"]); }
      }
      if (tool == null || tool.Length == 0) { tool = "unknown"; }
      if (agent == null) { agent = ""; }
      return agent.Replace("\n", "") + "\n" + tool;
    } catch { return ""; }
  }" />

@{
  var call = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-mcp-call"]);
  var cut = call.IndexOf("\n");
  var agentId = call.Substring(0, cut);
  var toolName = call.Substring(cut + 1);
  var statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode;
  var latencyMs = (int)context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
  var productId = "{{aforo-mcp-product-id}}";

  var evt = new JObject(
    new JProperty("events", new JArray(
      new JObject(
        new JProperty("customerId", Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-event-customer"])),
        new JProperty("metricName", "mcp_server.tool_invocations"),
        new JProperty("quantity", 1),
        new JProperty("idempotencyKey",
          "mcp:" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-idempotency-key-base", "") +
          ":" + toolName),
        new JProperty("occurredAt", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
        new JProperty("productType", Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-event-product-type"])),
        new JProperty("toolName", toolName),
        new JProperty("agentId", agentId),
        new JProperty("sessionId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Mcp-Session-Id", "")),
        new JProperty("executionDurationMs", latencyMs),
        new JProperty("endpointPath", context.Request.Url.Path),
        new JProperty("httpMethod", context.Request.Method),
        new JProperty("statusCode", statusCode),
        new JProperty("responseTimeMs", latencyMs),
        new JProperty("trace", new JObject(
          new JProperty("traceparent", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("traceparent", null)),
          new JProperty("tracestate", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("tracestate", null)),
          new JProperty("xTraceId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-trace-id", null)),
          new JProperty("xRequestId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-request-id", null))
        )),
        new JProperty("metadata", new JObject(
          new JProperty("gateway", "azure-apim"),
          new JProperty("productId", productId == "none" ? "" : productId)
        ))
      )
    ))
  );
  var mcpOutcome = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-execution-status", "");
  if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(mcpOutcome)) {
    ((JObject)((JArray)evt["events"])[0]).Add("executionStatus", mcpOutcome);
  }
  return evt.ToString();
}

@{
  var path = context.Request.Url.Path;
  var method = context.Request.Method;
  var statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode;
  var latencyMs = (int)context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
  var traceparent = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("traceparent", null);
  var xTraceId = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-trace-id", null);

  string agenticTraceId = null;
  if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(traceparent)) {
    var parts = traceparent.Split('-');
    if (parts.Length == 4 &&
      System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(parts[0], "^[0-9a-fA-F]{2}$") &&
      parts[0].ToLower() != "ff" &&
      System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(parts[1], "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$") &&
      parts[1] != "00000000000000000000000000000000" &&
      System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(parts[2], "^[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$") &&
      parts[2] != "0000000000000000" &&
      System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(parts[3], "^[0-9a-fA-F]{2}$")) {
      agenticTraceId = parts[1].ToLower();
    }
  }
  if (agenticTraceId == null && !String.IsNullOrEmpty(xTraceId)) {
    var trimmed = xTraceId.Trim();
    if (trimmed.Length > 0) agenticTraceId = trimmed;
  }

  var eventObj = new JObject(
    new JProperty("customerId", Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-event-customer"])),
    new JProperty("metricName", Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-event-metric"])),
    new JProperty("quantity", 1),
    new JProperty("idempotencyKey",
      context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-idempotency-key-base", "")),
    new JProperty("occurredAt", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
    new JProperty("productType", agenticTraceId != null
      ? "AGENTIC_API" : Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-event-product-type"])),
    new JProperty("endpointPath", path),
    new JProperty("httpMethod", method),
    new JProperty("statusCode", statusCode),
    new JProperty("responseTimeMs", latencyMs),
    new JProperty("trace", new JObject(
      new JProperty("traceparent", traceparent),
      new JProperty("tracestate", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("tracestate", null)),
      new JProperty("xTraceId", xTraceId),
      new JProperty("xRequestId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-request-id", null))
    )),
    new JProperty("metadata", new JObject(
      new JProperty("gateway", "azure-apim"),
      new JProperty("method", method),
      new JProperty("path", path),
      new JProperty("status", statusCode),
      new JProperty("latency", latencyMs),
      new JProperty("subscription", context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : ""),
      new JProperty("operation", context.Operation != null ? context.Operation.Id : "")
    ))
  );
  if (agenticTraceId != null) {
    eventObj.Add("traceId", agenticTraceId);
  }
  var outcome = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-execution-status", "");
  if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(outcome)) {
    eventObj.Add("executionStatus", outcome);
  }

  var evt = new JObject(
    new JProperty("events", new JArray(eventObj))
  );
  return evt.ToString();
}
